headline: Multi-omic and cross-species profiling maps gene regulatory logic across tissues
label: Multimodal Gene Regulation Modeling
summary: Single-cell multiome and epigenomic profiling across species is now paired with predictive models to infer conserved regulatory networks.
synthesis: The dominant thread is computational inference of regulatory logic by combining multiple data modalities across species and cell types. The cerebellum study pairs cross-species single-nucleus RNA and ATAC profiling of six mammals with sequence-based models, while the basal ganglia platform integrates single-cell multi-omics across four species. MoDIFI integrates RNA-seq, ATAC-seq and Hi-C in a Bayesian framework to prioritize regulatory regions for neurodevelopmental variants. Clean infers dynamic lncRNA regulatory networks in autism spectrum disorder. FAScore integrates 19 features to predict functional exon skipping across hematopoietic lineage commitment in six vertebrates. The IDR study is more peripheral. What is new is pairing multi-species, multimodal profiling with predictive modeling across splicing, disordered regions and chromatin-based network inference.
